## 📦 Overview

This repository contains the complete, district-standard **digital handoff package** for this facility.  
It is fully static and can be used:

- By Facilities Management staff  
- Offline and in air-gapped environments  
- For inspections, audits, repair planning, and O&M activities  
- As a long-term, version-controlled record of building data  
- For integration with downstream FM tools and IoT dashboards

All data is validated and packaged according to district-level **Data Governance & Provenance Requirements**.
